C-AUTO-TELEMETRY-CONNECTION.Summary: Compact GT7 home telemetry strip, optional automatic local PlayStation discovery/connection, and actual current car name and manufacturer logo.

Goals.Goal: Reduce normal desktop panel height to roughly 110–130 logical pixels and phone height to roughly 160–190 without reducing legibility or tap targets.
Find an active PlayStation in the local network, request C, and display the car resolved from validated telemetry through the existing bundled CarCatalog.
Persist an application-wide automatic discovery/connection switch, enabled by default; retain manual settings and connection.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep the selected GT7 graphite/white visual language, SVG art and PS4/PS5 marks; use Provider/ChangeNotifier, existing typed RU/EN localization, FVM and central DI.
Only validated protocol replies are console candidates. A successfully bound local UDP socket, successful send, TCP refusal or MAC prefix never proves live GT7 telemetry.
Automatic discovery must be bounded, cancellable and foreground-only. Never scan the whole subnet, open Remote Play sessions, authenticate to PSN, wake or launch the console automatically.

Automatic discovery must never interrupt manual connection or demo. Explicit disconnect suppresses reconnect for the current session. Disabled discovery cancels pending automatic work without dropping an active user connection.

Support physical iOS honestly: broadcast discovery requires Apple's multicast entitlement, currently absent. Retain direct-IP/saved-address fallback; availability of required provisioning must be verified before claiming first-run broadcast discovery on physical iPhone.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new telemetry packet fields, full dashboard redesign, account integration, PSN authentication, automatic console wake-up, commit or push.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Compact RU/EN layout fits 320–1440 and enlarged text, with clear text-labelled searching/waiting/live/not-found/multiple-console/manual states, distinct primary/secondary actions, and at least 44px button targets.

Current car name and corresponding manufacturer logo appear only from validated telemetry carId; logo loading failure uses manufacturer text; unknown IDs and missing data have honest fallbacks. Automatic connection leaves the user on Home.
One verified active console may connect automatically; multiple consoles require a saved confirmed target or user selection. C is requested by default.
Automatic discovery toggle persists under GT menu / Settings / Global / Telemetry, applies immediately and is also reachable from connection settings.
Last confirmed console address is remembered only after actual valid telemetry; expired packets, disconnected consoles and later scan results cannot show stale car data or restart cancelled work.

Tests cover persistence, cancellation, lifetime, multiple candidates, false positives, backgrounding, manual override, missing data, stale data, reconnect and localized layout. Verify real macOS and narrow iPhone UI with muted test entrypoints and stop all instances afterwards.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: Dart MCP unit/widget tests, resource audit, changed-file analysis and GRACE assertions after approval.
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Native macOS and narrow iPhone screenshots and interactions; fixture/loopback discovery evidence; explicitly bounded physical-console and iOS signing limits.
